title: 感性とデザイン
subtitle: Kansei(Sensitivity) and Design
courseType: （全課程からの提供）リベラルアーツ系科目文理横断
educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In this course, students will learn how to demonstrate your creativity and design
skills, after having done some rudimentary exercises to hone your sensibilities. T
hey will work on practical skills such as clay work and drawing. Students will als
o learn about creation systematically in lectures and study the transition of desi
gn. They will learn how to apply and utilize their skills to their own field of ex
pertise.
advice:
The objectives of this course are for students to understand;
- Understand their own biases and be able to look at things from a bird's eye view.
- Cultivate one's eyesight for understanding the essence of matter.
- Learn how to create their own answers.
- Enjoy and actively engage in class.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The objectives of this course are for students to understand;
- Understand their own biases and be able to look at things from a bird's eye view.
- Cultivate one's eyesight for understanding the essence of matter.
- Learn how to create their own answers.
- Enjoy and actively engage in class.
